name: Lost
descr: The goods that hang in no section: a goods loses its last section and drops out of every window that walks the catalogue - this is where it is found again. From here it goes back into a section, or out of the store for good. Deleting a goods happens nowhere else, and it goes by the operations of a person, not by the right of a section: a goods hanging nowhere has no section to hold a right.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr:
Every goods hanging in no section, page after page. No field narrows it: this is the whole of what is lost, and found says how many that is. Searching among them - by a code, by a part of a name, by id - is CmdQuery.

The goods come by id, so a walk of many pages loses none and says none twice.

params.name: limit
params.descr: how many of the lost goods to answer with; found says how many there are in all, so a page is chosen knowing the size

params.name: offset
params.descr: how many of them to step over before this page - 100 takes the second page of a hundred

commands.name: CmdQuery

params.name: query
params.descr: the query itself, as the shape above; left out or empty, the command answers what may be named in one

params.name: limit
params.descr: how many of the lost goods to answer with; found says how many there are in all, so a page is chosen knowing the size

params.name: offset
params.descr: how many of them to step over before this page - 100 takes the second page of a hundred

commands.name: CmdLink
commands.descr: Hangs a lost goods back into a section, at the end of it.

params.name: store_id
params.descr: id of the lost goods, or several of them

params.name: topic_id
params.descr: id of the section it comes back into

commands.name: CmdRemove
commands.descr: Deletes a lost goods from the store for good, with everything hanging on it - its characteristics, its parameters, its files. It goes at once, on this one call: no Recovery of the program brings it back. Orders keep their lines - an order line carries its own copy of the name.

params.name: store_id
params.descr: id of the lost goods, or several of them
